name.local: 赛诺菲-华平医疗健康创新基金

strategy.thesis: Joint fund between French pharma Sanofi and Franco-Chinese investor Cathay Capital, investing in clinical-stage innovative-medicine pipelines and related industry opportunities in China, launched to support Shanghai's biomedical sector development to international standards.

summary.en: A RMB 2 billion (~$274M) joint fund launched April 2025 by Sanofi and Cathay Capital in Shanghai's Jing'an district, investing in China's clinical-stage innovative-medicine pipeline as part of Shanghai's push to advance pharmaceutical innovation to international standards.

sources.title: $274m fund launched in Jing'an to boost pharma innovation
sources.supports: fund name, size, backers, launch date, focus, quote
sources.quote: The inauguration of the fund is a significant step towards advancing China's pharmaceutical innovation to leading international standards. - Cai Mingpo, founder and president of Cathay Capital

verification_notes: Single-source verified (official Shanghai government portal); could not cross-confirm with a second independent outlet in this pass. Fund's formal English/Chinese branded name not independently confirmed beyond the government article's description — 'Sanofi-Cathay Capital Healthcare Innovation Fund' is this researcher's rendering of 'the pharma innovation fund launched in Jing'an by Sanofi and Cathay Capital'; team should verify exact official name before publishing. [fact-check: Shanghai municipal government source confirms RMB 2bn / $274.46M size, April 24 2025 launch, Jing'an location, Sanofi + Cathay Capital as backers, and the Cai Mingpo quote verbatim. Fully verified from the single cited (official government) source.]

backers.note: French pharma co-anchors the RMB 2B ($274M) fund alongside Cathay Capital.

backers.note: Franco-Chinese private-equity/venture firm co-managing the fund.

strategy.thesis: Node of Bayer's global Co.Lab life-sciences incubator network hosting China-based biotech startups; in September 2025 launched the 'AdVenture' platform to connect resident startups with a curated network of external Chinese VC firms for financing and strategic advice.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Resident startups get Bayer Co.Lab facility access plus, via AdVenture, introductions to partner VCs SIIC, Legend Capital, IDG Capital and Bayland Capital for investment opportunities.

summary.en: Shanghai node of Bayer's global Co.Lab incubator network (marked its first anniversary in September 2025, implying a ~2024 opening); in September 2025 Bayer layered on the new 'Co.Lab AdVenture' platform connecting resident biotech startups to a curated network of external VC partners (SIIC, Legend Capital, IDG Capital, Bayland Capital) for financing.

sources.title: Bayer launches Bayer Co.Lab AdVenture platform in China to accelerate access to global investment network enhancing biotech innovation
sources.supports: AdVenture platform launch date, VC partners, purpose
sources.quote: Bayer Co.Lab AdVenture bridges tenants of high-potential biotech startups with leading venture capital firms, accelerating access to global financing and investment networks.

sources.title: Bayer Co.Lab marks one-year anniversary in China
sources.supports: implies Co.Lab Shanghai opening around September 2024
